ModMetaData.name: Letter Controller
ModMetaData.author: Hiroaki Yamamoto and Gemini
ModMetaData.description:
Take full control over RimWorld's letter notifications!
Features: - Configurable in Options > Mod Options at any time (main menu or during gameplay). - Real-time keyword search to quickly locate specific event letters. - Filter letters by DLC or mod source. - Complete catalog of all letters including vanilla, DLCs, and modded letters. - Sort by Title, Mod, or Behavior. - Custom behaviors per letter: - Default: Respects the vanilla "Pause on Letter" game option. - Ignore: Completely suppresses the letter and arrival sound. - Pause: Forces the game to pause when the letter arrives even if not covered by "Pause on Letter". - Immediate effect: All setting changes apply instantly without reloading the game.
